story_type: crewed night launch filmed by a high-speed camera
hook: Four people sat on top of this rocket as it lit up the night.
narration: Four people sat on top of this rocket as it lit up the night.
This was SpaceX Crew-12, lifting off from Cape Canaveral, Florida, at five fifteen in the morning.
A high-speed camera filmed it, so a few seconds of liftoff stretch out like this.
The Falcon Nine fires all nine of its first stage engines at once, and climbs on a column of flame.
On board were two NASA astronauts, one from Europe and one from Russia.
From farther back, a second camera watched the whole sky turn orange.
outcome: All four launched toward the International Space Station, headed for a long stay aboard.

location_card.place: Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida

title: Crew-12 liftoff in slow motion
description:
A high-speed camera recorded the liftoff of NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 mission at 5:15 a.m. EST on Feb. 13, 2026, from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, carrying four astronauts to the International Space Station.
